rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for arranging decorations in a room, venue, or on a tree.

example.english: We need to decorate the venue tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋聽日要佈置個場地。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 bou3 zi3 go3 coeng4 dei6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the act of putting ornamental items on an object rather than arranging a space.

example.english: You can decorate the cake with some flowers.
example.traditional: 你可以用啲花裝飾個蛋糕。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 di1 faa1 zong1 sik1 go3 daan6 gou1

rows.note: Use this for decorating or renovating an interior, especially when the work involves paint, fixtures, or other building work.

example.english: We’re going to decorate our flat next month.
example.traditional: 我哋間屋下個月開始裝修。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 zong1 sau1

rows.note: Use this formal verb for conferring an official medal, order, or other service decoration on someone.

example.english: The government will decorate that firefighter today.
example.traditional: 政府今日會授勳畀嗰位消防員。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gam1 jat6 wui5 sau6 fan1 bei2 go2 wai2 siu1 fong4 jyun4
